title: Clinical observation of the efficacy of Bevacizumab combined with argon green laser in treating fundus macular edema

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs License); PRIVATE

condition: Macular edema ('fundus macular edema') of unstated aetiology (Table I caption mentions 'macula rhegmatogenous retinal detachment'); patients previously untreated by surgery or medicine; randomised two-arm study (First Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University, May 2009 to April 2013), 78 patients (39 cases per group)

groups.agent: intravitreal bevacizumab (Avastin) 0.05 mL plus argon green laser photocoagulation of leaking spots
groups.description: Experimental group: bevacizumab combined with argon green laser

groups.agent: argon green laser photocoagulation of leaking spots (500 µm to 1 mm from the fovea, 50-100 µm spots, 0.1 s, 75-100 mW)
groups.description: Control group: argon green laser alone

series.baseline_label: Before surgery (Table II row Experimental, column 'Before surgery (µm)')
series.notes: Mean ± SD (Methods: all quantitative data as mean ± SD); times count from treatment ('surgery'): 1 day = 1/30.4375 months (0.0329), 1, 3 and 6 months; n counts cases (patients), eyes per patient not stated; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Before surgery (Table II row Control, column 'Before surgery (µm)')
series.notes: Mean ± SD; same timing as the experimental series; n counts cases (patients)

exclusions.what: Table II T-value and P-value rows
exclusions.reason: test statistics and p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table III logMAR-BCVA and Table IV time to best-corrected visual acuity
Table V effectiveness counts and rates, Table VI complication counts

notes: Time origin: the treatment session ('surgery': intravitreal injection and/or laser); the number of injections or laser sessions is not stated, so regimen unstated
Aetiology of the macular edema is not stated (indication other); exclusion of patients previously 'treated with surgery or medicine' gives prior_treatment naive
OCT device and the definition of 'central foveal thickness of the macular lutea' are not stated (device unstated, measure central_unspecified)
